findings.type: ignored-param drilldown (same class as ProjectsPage rag) + Law-9 lie
findings.detail: RmKpiStrip.tsx:94 links the 'Idle Resources' KPI (value 5) to /people?filter=idle. The destination EmployeeDirectoryPage (EmployeeDirectoryPage.tsx:48) builds its URL-filter set with useFilterParams(defaults) where defaults = {departmentId, lifecycleStatus:'ACTIVE', resourcePoolId, search, view:'directory', role, grade, layout, groupBy, selected}. 'filter' is NOT a default key. useFilterParams (useFilterParams.ts:22-28) only reads keys present in defaults, so ?filter=idle is silently dropped — identical mechanism to the ProjectsPage 'rag' ignored-param finding. The page then renders the full lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE directory. Live: KPI=5 idle, but the drilldown lands on 198 ACTIVE people (GET /api/org/people total=201, ACTIVE=198). The KPI promises a filtered list of 5 and delivers an unfiltered list of 198.
findings.correctTarget: /people?view=bench (the directory already has a Bench tab via ?view=bench backed by fetchEnrichedBench/isOnBench); 'filter=idle' has no handler at all.

findings.type: same ignored-param link reused in chart legend
findings.detail: ResourcePoolUtilizationDonut.tsx:19 also links the 'Idle' slice to /org/people?filter=idle — same dead param, same destination behavior. Confirms the broken pattern is not a one-off typo.

KPI counts the RM's 5 managed people; /people drilldown shows the org-wide ACTIVE directory (198) with no manager/scope filter. Number is correct vs its source, but the drilldown does not reproduce the 5. Not an ignored-param bug (no param emitted), but it violates the spirit of Law-9 (KPI should link to the filtered list that produced it).

evidence: Live as resource_manager sophia.kim (personId bbbb0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000006). GET /api/dashboard/resource-manager/<pid> -> 200; summary.peopleWithoutAssignmentsCount=5, totalManagedPeopleCount=5, managedTeamCount=1, allocationIndicators all UNASSIGNED (OVERALLOCATED=0). RmKpiStrip 'Idle Resources' KPI shows 5 and links to /people?filter=idle. EmployeeDirectoryPage's useFilterParams default set has no 'filter' key (EmployeeDirectoryPage.tsx:48); useFilterParams.ts only reads default keys, so ?filter=idle is ignored — same class as ProjectsPage 'rag'. The drilldown therefore lands on the full ACTIVE directory: GET /api/org/people?pageSize=200 -> 200, total=201, ACTIVE=198. KPI=5 vs drilldown list=198. Second instance of the same dead link at ResourcePoolUtilizationDonut.tsx:19 (/org/people?filter=idle). All 5 KPI values themselves match their dashboard-endpoint source fields; only the drilldown filtering is broken.
